notes: Free basic vet care for cats and dogs for South Bronx residents. Only for owners living in zip codes 10451, 10454, 10455, 10456 or 10459. Bring proof of public assistance: NYCHA, Medicaid, SSI, SSDI, welfare, TANF, or SNAP/WIC. Exams, vaccines, spay/neuter and in-house tests are free for eligible owners; a microchip is $10. Appointments only: check eligibility and book through the ASPCA's online form. For an emergency, go to an emergency hospital instead. Also offers subsidized dental cleanings and extractions.

Rebuilt from the ASPCA's own page for the South Bronx clinic, read in a browser: eligible zips, proof needed, free services.
